instruction: Adjust the mailbox purge threshold to 50 MB to free up more disk space.

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing purge threshold from 20 MB to 50 MB. The evaluator checks if mail.purge_threshold_mb is set to 50. Original profile has purge_threshold_mb=20, so this requires modification. Uses existing check_thunderbird_prefs metric.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction requirement: checking if mail.purge_threshold_mb preference is set to 50
Postconfig appropriately closes Thunderbird window (with 0.5s wait) to ensure prefs.js is flushed to disk before retrieval
Getter correctly retrieves prefs.js from VM using get_vm_file with correct path
Metric check_thunderbird_prefs correctly parses prefs.js file and compares preference values using _match_pref
Expected value (50 MB) is semantically correct for the instruction requirement
Data flow is correct: VM file -> parse prefs.js -> check mail.purge_threshold_mb == 50
Metric function correctly handles expected parameter when type='rule': receives rules dict directly from get_rule, accesses rule.get('expect', {})
Complete coverage: instruction has single requirement (set threshold to 50 MB) and evaluator checks exactly that
